title: READ-004: Extract Users component modal logic
description: The Users component has 157 lines of script logic with multiple concerns (user list management, create user modal, edit role modal, delete confirmation, token copying, installer download). Extracting modal logic to composables reduces complexity and improves maintainability.

concerns: Create user modal (UI state, form validation, API call)
Edit role modal (UI state, role selection, API call)
Delete confirmation modal (UI state, confirmation, API call)
context.goal: Extract modal logic to reduce complexity; optional full composable extraction

acceptance_criteria: Component complexity is reduced (or extract to composable)
Modal logic is self-contained and testable
User list management remains in component (main concern)
At least one modal logic extracted (create or delete)
Component still functions correctly after refactoring
Code is easier to read and maintain

implementation_notes.approach_1_minimal: Extract inline event handlers to named functions; keep in component
implementation_notes.approach_2_composable:
Create useDeleteUserModal.ts composable with:
- showDeleteConfirmModal ref
- deletingUser ref
- handleDeleteUser function
- handleConfirmDelete function
- cancel handler
implementation_notes.optional_approach: If full composable extraction is too heavy, extract delete confirmation logic inline with clear comments
implementation_notes.location: New file: dashboard/src/composables/useDeleteUserModal.ts (or useUserModal.ts for all modals)

unit_test: Test delete modal state transitions (open, confirm, cancel, close)
Test API call with valid/invalid responses
component_test: Render Users component with extracted modal logic
Verify modal displays when delete button clicked
manual_test: Confirm delete and verify user is removed
Test error scenario (if API returns error)

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — structural refactoring, safe to revert
notes: This refactoring is optional full composable extraction or minimal inline extraction. Either approach reduces component complexity. Full composable extraction (useDeleteUserModal, useCreateUserModal) is more powerful but may be over-engineering for this component size.
